actions.reason: K8_C0001 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity (coordinated OXPHOS/mitochondrial-metabolism down-regulation with a mitochondrial respiratory-chain/TCA leading edge) and its current membership is positively represented in the wxs patient geometry (mean silhouette 0.906, no negative silhouettes, within-set distance far below between-set). No measured technical/acquisition factor survives correction (largest raw ct_reconstruction_kernel q=0.234), so no material measured alternative explanation remains. The partition-level screen shows no internal subdivision signal, and no exact-pair evidence supports removing a boundary, so continued treatment as an independent candidate unit is supported.

K8_C0002 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity (strong immune/interferon down-regulation with OXPHOS and fatty-acid metabolism up-regulation and an HLA/T-cell/interferon leading edge). Its boundary against the closest candidate K8_C0003 is positively represented at the pair level: mean silhouettes are positive in all four modalities (ct 0.061, rna 0.055, wsi 0.120, wxs 0.047) with within-set distances below between-set distances, so the pair evidence supports preserving rather than removing the boundary. No measured technical/acquisition factor is significant after correction (all q>=0.709), and no internal subdivision signal was detected, so independent retention is supported.

K8_C0003 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity (coordinated TNFA/NFKB inflammatory, interferon-alpha, allograft-rejection, protein-secretion, and UPR up-regulation with an NFKB/EGR/CXCL leading edge). Its membership is positively represented in ct and wsi geometry (mean silhouettes 0.115 and 0.036, few negative silhouettes, within-set distance below between-set), and its boundary against the closest candidate K8_C0002 is positively represented at the pair level (positive mean silhouettes in all four modalities). Although tissue_source_site, ct_scanner_model, ct_slice_thickness, and ct_z_spacing are significantly associated with membership, these are measured alternative explanations rather than established artifacts, and the positive membership and boundary representation together with the coherent phenotype support continued independent treatment.

K8_C0004 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity (strong immune/interferon and EMT down-regulation with an HLA/T-cell/interferon leading edge). Its membership is positively represented in ct, rna, and wsi geometry (positive mean silhouettes 0.039, 0.050, 0.267; within-set distance below between-set), and its boundary against the closest candidate K8_C0006 is positively represented at the pair level (positive mean silhouettes in all four modalities, within-set below between-set). No measured technical/acquisition factor survives correction (ct_slice_thickness/ct_z_spacing q=0.118), and no internal subdivision signal was detected, so independent retention is supported.

K8_C0005 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity (strong interferon, allograft-rejection, IL6-JAK-STAT3, inflammatory, and complement up-regulation with an interferon-stimulated/antigen-presentation leading edge). Its membership is positively represented in rna geometry (mean silhouette 0.093, only 3/20 negative, within-set distance below between-set). No measured technical/acquisition factor survives correction (tissue_source_site and ct_phase q=0.176), the partition screen shows no internal subdivision signal, and no exact-pair evidence supports removing a boundary, so independent retention is supported.

K8_C0006 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity (OXPHOS, EMT, glycolysis, ROS, mTORC1, and xenobiotic-metabolism down-regulation with WNT/beta-catenin, mitotic-spindle, Hedgehog, and angiogenesis up-regulation). Its boundary against K8_C0004 is positively represented at the pair level (positive mean silhouettes in all four modalities), and its boundary against K8_C0008 is positively represented in wxs (mean silhouette 0.400, only 1/15 negative, within-set distance far below between-set). No measured technical/acquisition factor is associated with membership (all V=0.0, all q=1.0), and no internal subdivision signal was detected, so independent retention is supported.

K8_C0007 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity (EMT, UV-response-DN, mitotic-spindle, Hedgehog, angiogenesis, and apical-junction up-regulation with OXPHOS and MYC-targets-V2 down-regulation and a matrix/EMT leading edge). Its membership is positively represented in wxs geometry (mean and median silhouette 1.0, no negative silhouettes, zero within-set distance). No measured technical/acquisition factor survives correction (all q>=0.54), the partition screen shows no internal subdivision signal, and no exact-pair evidence supports removing a boundary, so independent retention is supported.

K8_C0008 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity (G2M-checkpoint, E2F, mTORC1, and MYC proliferation up-regulation with interferon/allograft-rejection/IL6-JAK-STAT3 down-regulation and a cell-cycle leading edge). Its membership is positively represented in wxs geometry (mean silhouette 0.192, only 2/7 negative, within-set distance well below between-set), and its boundary against K8_C0006 is positively represented in wxs at the pair level (mean silhouette 0.400, within-set distance far below between-set). No measured technical/acquisition factor survives correction (all q>=0.273), and no internal subdivision signal was detected, so independent retention is supported.
